faq.title: Good to know.
faq.lead: Every project is different, but these are the questions small businesses ask us most.

items.question: Are your websites really affordable for a small business?
items.answer: Yes. We shape the scope around what your business needs most, so you can launch a professional site without paying for unnecessary pages or features.

items.question: Can you create an AI commercial without a traditional video shoot?
items.answer: Yes. Depending on the concept, we can combine product images, AI-generated scenes, motion, voiceover, music, and editing to create a polished commercial.

items.question: What kind of business tasks can you automate?
items.answer: Common examples include lead capture, qualification, follow-up emails, appointment reminders, content generation, document workflows, and updates between business tools.

items.question: Do I need to understand AI or technology?
items.answer: No. We explain the project in business language, keep the system practical, and show you exactly how to use what we build.
